rights.title: Your rights as a data subject
rights.description: Under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to:
list: 1. Right to information and transparency – you have the right to know what data we collect, why, and how long we store it.
2. Right to access – you can request a copy of your personal data.
3. Right to rectification – ask us to correct incorrect or incomplete data.
4. Right to erasure – request deletion of your data if there is no legal basis for retaining it.
5. Right to restriction of processing – request limited processing if you question the data's accuracy.
6. Right to data portability – receive your data in a machine-readable format.
7. Right to withdraw consent – you may withdraw your consent at any time.
8. Right to lodge a complaint – you can file a complaint with IMY if you believe your data was mishandled.
rights.title2: What happens to my data if I stop using the app or my license is revoked?
list2: Deleted: We remove your personal data, such as name, email, profile, chats, and course progress.
Retained for a period: Certain data, such as receipts, invoices, and logs, must be stored for accounting and security purposes. These are kept for at least 7 years in accordance with the law.
Anonymization: Data that must be stored due to legal requirements is anonymized as far as possible.
After legal requirements: Once the statutory retention period has passed, all data is permanently deleted or anonymized.

storage.title: Stored data
points: Chat logs are anonymized or deleted regularly after the session ends.
Email addresses and support tickets are stored only to improve support services.
